name: notify
summary: Display GitHub notifications in the terminal.
best_for: Developers who want notification awareness without the browser.
avoid_if: You already manage notifications through email or mobile.

name: gonest
summary: Remove phantom notifications from inaccessible repositories.
best_for: Users stuck with notifications from deleted or inaccessible repositories.
avoid_if: Your notification inbox is already clean.

name: triage
summary: Manage issues and pull requests through unread notifications.
best_for: Maintainers who triage from their notification inbox.
avoid_if: You do not use GitHub notifications as a work queue.

name: not
best_for: Users who need filtering and rule-based notification handling.
avoid_if: You only need to view notifications occasionally.
